description.from: Add the Plexus-owned ECR repository and image pipeline for the portable command-worker artifact. Build the package Dockerfile from the source revision, publish immutable commit-addressed images, expose the resolved digest as deployment input, and validate the synthesized IAM and image build configuration. Do not update Amplify environment variables or deploy consumer-specific resources.
description.to: Produce a genuinely buildable Plexus-owned command-worker container artifact and immutable publication path. The image must install the executor dependencies needed by supported dashboard commands, pass a real container build and startup smoke test, and publish a digest consumed by the companion deployment. Do not modify the mixed infrastructure application, Amplify environment variables, or existing production resources.
